sources.title: Knowledge Distillation: Compressing Large Models into Efficient Learners
sources.snippet: Knowledge distillation compresses large models into smaller ones by training a student to match a teacher's outputs. It enables fast, lightweight deployment on limited hardware with minimal accuracy loss and supports vision, language, and multi-teacher use cases.

sources.title: Knowledge distillation - Wikipedia
sources.snippet: In machine learning, knowledge distillation or model distillation is the process of transferring knowledge from a large model to a smaller one. While large models (such as very deep neural networks or ensembles of many models [1]) have more knowledge capacity than small models, this capacity might not be fully utilized. sources.title: A Survey on Knowledge Distillation of Large Language Models
sources.snippet: The concept of knowledge distillation in the field of AI and deep learning (DL) refers to the process of transferring knowledge from a large, complex model (teacher) to a smaller, more efficient model (student) Gou et al. (2021).
